python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import QPoint
from PySide6.QtGui import QAction
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
host_layout = QVBoxLayout(%PARENT%)
host_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
card = fluentqt.Card(%PARENT%)
host_layout.addWidget(card)
card_layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
card_layout.setContentsMargins(16, 12, 16, 14)
card_layout.setSpacing(6)
heading = fluentqt.Label("Current location", card)
heading.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
heading.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
card_layout.addWidget(heading)
control = fluentqt.Breadcrumb(card)
control.setItems([fluentqt.BreadcrumbItem(text) for text in ("Workspace", "Engineering", "FluentQt", "Components", "Navigation", "Breadcrumb")])
card_layout.addWidget(control)
summary = fluentqt.Label("Path depth: 6 levels", card)
summary.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
summary.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
card_layout.addStretch(1)
card_layout.addWidget(summary)
overflow_menu = fluentqt.FluentMenu("Overflow", control)
control.itemsChanged.connect(lambda: summary.setText("Empty path" if control.itemCount() == 0 else f"Path depth: {control.itemCount()} levels ({control.itemAt(control.itemCount() - 1).text})"))
control.itemActivated.connect(lambda index, item: summary.setText(f"Opened: {item.text} (level {index + 1})"))
def show_overflow(hidden_indexes):
    if not hidden_indexes:
        return
    overflow_menu.clear()
    for index in hidden_indexes:
        text = control.itemAt(index).text
        action = overflow_menu.addAction(text)
        action.triggered.connect(lambda checked=False, target=index, label=text: (
            summary.setText(f"Opened from menu: {label} (level {target + 1})"),
            control.setItems(control.items()[:target + 1]) if control.autoTruncateOnItemClick() else None,
        ))
    anchor = control.overflowGeometry()
    overflow_menu.popup(control.mapToGlobal(anchor.bottomLeft() if anchor.isValid() else QPoint(0, control.height())))
control.overflowActivated.connect(show_overflow)
